name: SWE Arena
publication_title: Owner’s site commit adding its SWE Arena project announcement; not a separately asserted launch day.
description: Compare models on iterative software requests.
input: A user request and the evolving code or conversation.
output: Candidate solutions to the same software task.
assessment: Interactive comparisons; evaluation depends on the selected task and comparison mode.

name: Agent Arena
publication_title: Agent Arena: Causal Evaluation of Agents in the Real World (published June 4; later methodology updates are separate)
description: Compare agent components on real user work.
input: User requests and an instrumented agent environment.
assessment: Randomized component assignment estimates effects on observed outcome signals; it is not an ordinary preference vote.

name: ToolArena
publication_title: Dated owner repository history under this project name: Basic runtime
description: Turn a repository into a callable, testable tool.
input: A software repository and function specification.
output: A tool implementation in the task environment.
assessment: Each task has its own tests of the implementation.

name: reasoning-arena
publication_title: Dated owner repository history under this project name: feat: reasoning-arena v0.1.0 — multi-provider LLM benchmark
description: Answer a suite of math, logic and multistep questions.
assessment: Question-specific grading with score, time and cost reporting; distinct from the same-name trace-tournament training paper.

name: mm-arena
publication_title: Dated owner repository history under this project name: Add Claude 5.5 results on core-v1, README, methodology, related work, figures
description: Quote prices in an explicitly specified market-making game. MM means market making here.
input: A market description and trade observations.
assessment: Expected trading performance relative to a Bayesian reference quoter.

name: Vision Arena
publication_title: The Multimodal Arena is Here! First leaderboard announcement; the article records earlier image battles.
input: The same image and prompt for two models.
assessment: Human head-to-head preferences determine the vision ranking; the automated VisionArena-Bench subset is distinct.

name: Video-Arena
publication_title: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
description: Reason about game recordings with known state.
input: A video and a task query.
output: A prediction about scene state or spatiotemporal events.
assessment: Task-specific checks use ground truth derived from the game environment.

name: Embodied Arena
publication_title: Embodied Arena: A Comprehensive, Unified, and Evolving Evaluation Platform for Embodied AI
description: Compare embodied models across multiple established tasks.
input: Task-specific visual, spatial or language inputs.
output: An answer, navigation action or plan, depending on the task.
assessment: Underlying benchmark metrics; the suite exposes separate capability and benchmark views.

name: RoboArena
publication_title: RoboArena: Distributed Real-World Evaluation of Generalist Robot Policies
description: Compare two policies performing the same task in the real world.
input: A task instruction and robot observations.
output: Robot actions in matched physical trials.
assessment: Double-blind pairwise preference judgments are aggregated across evaluators.

name: Alignment Arena
task: Social bias in masked language models
publication_title: Dated owner repository history under this project name: Create README.md
description: Probe differences in masked-token predictions across demographic contexts.
input: Text prompts for a masked language model.
assessment: Shared bias probes and metrics permit comparisons across models.

name: MemoryArena
publication_title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
description: Use knowledge acquired in one session to complete a dependent task in another.
input: An interactive task with dependencies on past sessions.
output: Task actions or answers informed by earlier experience.
assessment: Task success across dependent sessions rather than isolated fact recall.

name: ResearchArena
publication_title: ResearchArena: Benchmarking Large Language Models' Ability to Collect and Organize Information as Research Agents
description: Find, select and organize relevant research literature.
input: A research topic and paper corpus.
output: Selected papers and an organized overview.
assessment: Separate measures for literature discovery, selection and organization; unrelated to the later research-agent control evaluation.

name: PostTrain Arena
publication_title: Co-launch post linked by the benchmark homepage; UTC date from the official post identifier.
description: Assess the training benefit of an environment collection under a fixed recipe.
input: A fixed base model and submitted training environments.
output: Post-training performance on an independent held-out suite.
assessment: Held-out pass rate after training minus the corresponding rate before training, in percentage points.

name: LifeArena
publication_title: DesignArena: Introducing LifeArena, judged by real users
description: Compare assistants on people’s own everyday tasks.
input: The same real user request and connected applications.
assessment: Head-to-head user preferences aggregated over the recent evaluation window.

name: BenchArena
publication_title: Dated owner repository history under this project name: feat: initial bench-arena — agent loop vs stack profiler (latency, tokens, accuracy)
description: Compare an agent loop with a stack on a shared question corpus.
input: Factual, reasoning, legal, coding or metacognitive questions.
output: System responses under each execution approach.
assessment: Documented checks combine answer correctness with latency and token usage.

name: Game Arena
description: Play, not build: in Kaggle Game Arena, models face one another in chess, poker and Werewolf. Their match results determine the standings within each game.
input: Game rules and the observed state or history in the published text protocols
output: A legal move, bet or dialogue action, depending on the game
assessment: Compare models by head-to-head game outcomes under each game’s scoring protocol.
